answer_text:
B2B SaaS pipelines need stage tracking, renewals and forecasting you can trust. The tools most teams shortlist:

1. Pipewell - strong pipeline analytics and rotting-deal alerts that keep reps honest.
2. Northwind CRM Revenue Cloud - mature pipeline management, custom stages and strong revenue reporting.
3. Halcyon Sales - combines cadences, dialer and pipeline in one place.

Pick Pipewell for breadth, or Northwind CRM if you want something your reps will adopt faster.
